text: Ad free bliss. I’ve been using the timer function for years, for unguided meditations. After viewing Christopher’s (CEO?) video about the state of the world, I was firstly impressed that Insight Timer will never host/contain ads and then inspired to explore Nam Myoho Renge Kyo chanting. Absolute bliss! I’m more dedicated to my practice and will feel free to explore other practices on Insight Timer knowing I’m not going to get locked into something I wish I hadn’t. Love, love, love!!! 🙌❤️
The best!. My go to app for self care

Watch alert still broken. Latest update has not fixed the watch alert. The alert will sound when I wake my watch after the time has expired. I have a series 9 with latest os, background app refresh turned on, and ‘always on’ display turned off.

Authentic. After years of use the experience is improved with more advanced tools yet “no adds”and no “AI” Simple UX / UI and HCD is in constant development. Updates will include a Map of Healing. Science, Technology and Ancient Knowledge all verified. No other App has this@scale. Free Version has massive library that grows everyday, Live streams daily. Clear Clean Concise. Note: like all apps, user navigation takes practice, and improves with daily use, or once a week, no pressure. The most used and popular app, for healing and transformative growth. Suddenly freezing. Complete ceasefire on app access
Nighttime saviour. I wake two or three times a night and insight timer helps to get me back to sleep in around 5-10 minutes. I love this app!
Longtime user. Been using this app to set different meditation times. Great functionality.

Incredibly grateful. Thank you so much for building this! The features,  content and UI are all on point and give me a frictionless way for managing and improving my mindfulness. My sleep and daily energy are so much better since I jumped on Insight Timer!

Exactly the right app for each new day. Insight Timer is a treasure trove of excellent support for mindful practice, chilling out with music, deep meditation and help with sleeping. The range of experts who have shared their special talents provide varied audio and video support to help the world learn and grow as thinking, feeling, breathing, loving, reflective beings. I truly love the broad selection - suitable for those aged 1-100+, with something to suit individual experiences and needs. I recommend this app to my friends and family and use it daily.
Meh. Great app but I am sick of being asked questions every time I log in. I just want to use the app.

My forever meditation app. I have jumped between meditation, sleep and affirmation apps for years but never found one that fit. This app covers all the bases with a simple interface and the features you want, as well as in depth customisation and tailoring of your experience. It has great filters to find the type of meditation you need for any given moment and bookmarks, playlists and quick access features to make your favourites accessible. The daily intention and diversity of spiritual representation and selection is refreshing. This app represents a depth of history and culture, escapism when needed, mindful practices as well as current experts and practitioners contributing content and ideas. I could not recommend more!

no music!. I love this app,  however I have real problems with finding sleep meditations that DO NOT have loud music!  Many of them are so loud it is impossible to hear the narrator!   I hope that in future there will be more choice for sleep meditations to be just the voice and NO music! Please.

Best app for those that struggle to keep habits. I have always wanted to meditate regularly and have tried different apps, courses, group classes but nothing helped me keep up a regular and consistent practices until I was recommend this app.  It makes meditating not only easy but fun, and I have actually found it addictive! To be able to choose exactly the kind of meditation I want depending on my needs that day has been such a gift. I love that it is free but I love it so much that I have paid for the subscription too. I am so grateful to this app for changing my life for the better. No exaggeration! 🙏🏽💗🌞💓🙌🏽

Meditation app pushing new VIDEO features. Can’t turn off the video features. Why would anyone want to watch videos in a meditation app??? Isn’t the point to get off your phone and meditate? why does every app need VIDEOS now. Also why is the share button so obnoxiously large under the play button? Excellent sleep music by Darren J Benjamin though. This track is the only reason I keep on this app.
Fabulous. So happy I found the Insight Timer app. Full of beautiful content in all areas of self love and discovery!
Winner. Most used and enjoyable app  Great team behind the app and it is always updated and currently evolving  Beautiful meditations and works from across the world 🫶
Love it. I absolutely love this app so much
Best app. Such a wide range of free, quality content. I love the option to have a widget to track my meditation streak. I could not be happier.
Best meditation App around. Has the best selection of free resources and can help you to find the slice of meditation that you arre looking for.

Make a Commitment to Yourself. Using insight timer makes meditation accessible to everyone. So many free options, but having the yearly paid version helps keep me accountable. I am learning so much about my neurodivergence and am able to find something that works for me, every day, in order to continue a consistent practice of meditation highly recommend!
Grateful. Insight Timer is a godsend. I am so grateful to be able to find some help from the various, generous, kind & loving teachers 🙏
Got greedy. From $52 to $89 disgusting wont be recommending or renewing again and have been using for years!
Meditation & Sleep. This is in my top rotation of apps I use daily

My Nightly Routine. I use this app everyday & have for the past few years for sleep, morning meditation & now my ADHD diagnosis. I couldn’t live without it as it has so much to offer & the teachers are so warm & you find your favourites. It is an excellent app & well priced for what it delivers.

Life changing. I’ve used Insight Timer for around 10 years now and it’s part of my daily routine. I use it every night to get to sleep, and it’s also helped me get through some really tough times in my life. Grateful for this beautiful app. Can’t imagine life without it.

Amazing free app. The app is so good for being being, I love all the details, like when your meditation ends you can continue and it tracks your time until you complete it. Negative thing - so much advertisement for the upgrade or random retreats in other countries.

Best app for positive mindset development. Best app for positive mindset development  I have found so far realistic value and options to find a speakers that suit outlook on life to further my mental and inner development.

Life saver. Such a wonderful helpful app in many ways.  Love the short practices and there are so many. You can find your people here and save and follow as you like.  I’ve been using it daily for morning motivation, some yoga and to help me sleep.  Helped me get Unstuck!!! 10stars✨⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️✨⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Perfect application for daily meditation. Less subscription pages would be nice

Thank You. I joined insight timer when it first started many years ago and it has only continued to grow and improve every step of the way.  It’s an app I have recommended to my clients over and over again. Thank you for offering such an amazing platform that anyone can access from all walks of life.

Best app ever. This is the best app I have ever come across. I use it daily. I recommend to all people around me whether it’s  family, friends, or clients. The free version has absolutely everything already. I use the paid version for some deeper dives I am interested in, but also to support.

Floating in space. So many types of practices being offered.    Prior to discovering Insight I was averaging 3 to 4 hours sleep a night.  Besides having tinnitus  I do tend to allow anxiety get the better of me.  And allow those irritating marathon negative thoughts bombard my head.   Since putting into practice this wonderful app- Insight - my sleeping pattern in less disturbed and average sleep increased enormously.  I hooked onto Insight about a week ago.    Namaste.  John
Towards authentic life. The only app one needs - thank you insight timer

Daily connection. For over 600 days I’ve connected to Insight Timer and connected to myself through many as nd varied meditations. Thank you Insight timer for what you offer as it has changed my life.

Best app. I love insight timer and recommend it to anyone and everyone. The range of meditations available and the ability to filter is fantastic. To be available as a free resource is so special. Thank you so much to the insight timer team, thanks to you I get to meditate daily and am more grounded and less anxious. Super grateful.

Wonderful. I have used Insight Timer daily for 7 years now and have enjoyed many benefits from the variety of activities and experiences on offer. I have recommended this app to many friends as a powerful resource.
A bit annoying. Good app but these unskippable animations and commitments after meditating are annoying

Better & better. Well, what can I say except that as time goes on, the years Roll on now, I’m using Insight Timer more & more, loving it more & more. Things build, but so does this. Big fan, thanks to the team for all of their work.

Life changing. Insight has kept me grounded, motivated & inspired, through many turbulent years, it’s the app I turn to daily & the app I love having in my phone. It’s the only app I regularly recommend to others. Thank you thank you insight.
I’m so grateful for this App 💜🙏🏼 I use it everyday 😌. This app helps me to meditate 😌. I set my own timer for specific sessions & also enjoy the guided meditations & courses
Stop the pop ups!. I don’t want to be assaulted with the goal/moods pop ups when I open the app.   It makes me use waking up instead.
Predatory subscription. Haven’t used the app in ages. Didn’t realise the subscription had been renewed, no ability to request refund.

Just another money grabbing subscription app.. Don’t get stung by the ‘free trial’ strategy - you’ll end up with a yearly charge, randomly appear on your account ($89) and both the app and Apple blame each other and are practically impossible to contact to correct it.
I love this app!. The unpaid version is great I used it for years but the paid version gives you access to so much more.. definitely worth the money

Things I like & things that annoy me. First off there’s a great range of meditations to choose from. What I don’t like which has me looking around for something else is that I feel bullied by the constant “ did you meditate yesterday?” “ save your streak” “ start/ write in your journal” etc. I honestly just wish they’d leave me alone to do my own thing without the pressure.

I love love this app. I have been using insight timer daily for over a year. I love it! The practitioners are great, great search parameters, from topics, to sound hz, to length. But like most apps out there they slowly make all the good stuff available only to premium members. Lately there’s been a glitch as well where it won’t play through a long playlist to the end. I’ll put it on for sleep and I’ll wake up a few hours later and it’s no longer running 🤷🏼‍♀️

Sleep. I use this APP a lot in the last several years to help me switch my mind off and drift to sleep listening to bedtime stories and sleep music. And this APP just got bigger and best of all it's free to use. So anyone can use it.

Annoying questions. The timer is good but I’m so sick of getting annoying questions every time I open the app. I also don’t like that I need to commit to a time and number of data before using it when I know I’m just using the timer that day and do not want to commit to a daily practice. It feels like I need to lie just to use it.

An app that has it all!. A friend introduced me to Insight Timer and it has been a game changer in my life since then. I implement it daily and it helps me tune inwards into what I really need each day. Its resources assist in every aspect of life and I find it to be such a valuable tool. Thank you for creating and sharing such a brilliant app like Insight Timer, and making it easily accessible and available to anyone.

Kudos to the developers. I use this app everyday and I have to say kudos to the people behind this app, no ads or marketing tactics to get you to spend more. Free version is fantastic and paid version has great extra content that would be helpful and can support app so it can reach out to more people. Never seen a platform  like this that’s so generous to a world that needs peace and acceptance more than ever.
Cannot believe it free. For me as beginner it’s fantastic. I didn’t want a subscription as I wasn’t sure if i would stick to it. So far, it’s been great amd something for everyone
Can't believe it's free. Such a great app, the only thing that has got me consistently meditating. Ever.

Changes are not an improvement. Insight Timer used to be in my top 5 apps. I have used it every day for nearly 500 days and the new UX changes today are so disappointing. Guys! The quote on white was what I looked forward to before my morning meditation and I have to sift through the menus to find the timer. This is your core feature and you are making it hard to find!!! Feel this is pleasing shareholders (these changes appear to make me experience more of your app) at the expense of me as a meditator. Really disappointed, sorry. Hope it’s not final but as we all know, everything is impermanent so it’s kind of my issue… but still… :) Cheers ⚡️🙏
Insight timer is THE BEST!. Insight timer is the best meditation app!
Use this app daily. So many great teachers and variety of meditations for free. Talks are good too.
The serenity…love it. Love this app and it has lots of choices on what you are needing at the moment. It always gives the serenity I am needing…I think you…perfect.

The best!. Honestly the simplest, streamlined, user friendly app. Great community if you want to connect. An abundance resources that are inclusive while giving you the option of more features with the paid option.  You get it right? The best!

Brilliant , thankyou !. The best mediation app - I prefer this free version to other apps that I have  paid for  -  it offers such a diverse bank of meditation types (ie. Spiritual ones, body scans (very mater of fact) breathing exercises, targeted emotion meditations ) it is easy to use, logical and simple. Ideal for people on the go and great for beginners.

Amazing!!. I have used insight timer now almost everyday for about 4 years after a friend introduced me to it. It has taught me completely how to meditate by starting off with short guided mediations and I have moved on from there. Completely amazing app for the absolutely beginner right through to the advanced. There’s something here for everyone.

Achieving their goal…. One of Insight Timer’s goal was to create the biggest library of meditations and I believe they are achieving that and as a bonus they have the best app out there. I’ve been using it for a few years now on a very regular basis and to me this is of a gold standard. One of the reasons I chose Insight Timer in the beginning was because I wanted choice and I was getting bored really quickly with other meditation apps I was using (I’m still yet to get bored with IT). I love that I’m always discovering new pieces of music and meditation that feed and nurture my soul. Insight Timer have done a stellar job and the app just keeps getting better, I’ve recommended it to my friends. I cannot recommend it highly enough to anyone looking for a meditation app with a point of difference, IT wins hands down

Holy wow!. Absolutely love this app… the free 7 day meditation changed my life (as someone who’s hates, but is v aware of my penchant for informed superlatives). Jokes aside, knew meditation was for me. So stoked I found this one was it xx

FOR EVERY NEED. I have been using Insight Timer for many years now and find it invaluable on a daily basis. The functionality and features are constantly upgraded and the thousands upon thousands of meditations, talks, music ( including binaural/Solfeggio undertones) interviews etc ensure that for every need you search, you will receive dozens of options. It’s a kind and supportive community where you can connect with others from as close to your own town to as far as the other side of the globe. I wouldn’t want to be without it. ♥️♥️
The best. Best meditation app on the market.
Have tried a few meditation apps, this is easily the best. As the title says - easily the best meditation app I’ve come across
Love it. What did we ever do without insight timer?!

Life changer. I’m so glad this app was recommended to me, it is so versatile with endless guided meditations as well as the flexibility to do your own.  I don’t just use it for meditation I also use it while stretching and for prayer.

Social media for peace. I originally downloaded this for the meditation timer, but the whole app is honestly impressive and well worth exploring. The guided meditations have been used by colleagues in psychiatry settings, for relaxation group.
great app - minor UX issues. Hi there  I found that sometimes when using this app it is tricky to exit and navigate back to homepage.
Love this app.. So many different meditations and courses that are all accessible at no cost.  This has changed my life for the better. Thank you.
Where is the Timer now??. Used to use this app for the bell and timers for simple meditation and track the time. Now I can’t even find the timer. Why you still call yourself insight timer?

Amazing App!. Perfect app for the time poor. Pick a meditation based on time available and mood or requirement and go. And such a great diversity among the offerings. This morning Gisele Bündchen  talked me through manifestation - I did not see that coming 🤣

Highly recommend. This is such a wonderful app, I couldn’t live without it. I suffer terribly with sleeping issues. I use this every night to go to sleep and when I wake during the night, which is often, I just put on another meditation and usually am asleep before it’s finished.

Love it. Just started using this app yesterday and I love how it’s free and accessible without the stress of needing to pay a subscription fee. Absolutely amazing. I feel I can relax more and having the option to donate is such a beautiful idea.

No ads, meaningful use is free. Large amount of diverse spiritual audio in this app. Easy to use. Took me a little while to find the timer (even though it’s in the name) as I just dived into the audio. An almost overwhelming amount of material here, something for most points along the path. If you’re beginning, it’s great. If you want to deepen a longer journey, it’s great. I’m sure it could be better, but I can’t think of anything to criticise.
Best App. This is changing my life.  Exhausted gym owner with too much to think about at 2am in the morning. Loving Glenn Harrold
The best free meditation app. I’ve tried so many apps and the quality and variety of meditations offered here is the best I’ve found.

Nice meditation app. I'm finding this app quite and helpful. Quite a wide range of meditations. I myself am science based and not the spiritual woo and I've found many meditation that suit me. And if you are into all the spiritual stuff, there's plenty there for you.
Love it. Easy to use. Can always find something to fulfil my needs. Thank you to all the people that make this available.
A great resource. So many meditation styles for all levels. A must have.
Awesome!!!!. Love this app. Just need to use it more.

I love what this app has to offer and all the teachers, I’ve learnt a lot from it, but I’ve been struggling with the layout, it feels too busy and complicated which is a real shame.

Good for the soul. Insight timer has so many meditations that help the mind and soothe the soul. Highly recommend!

Opening screens. Paid for a sub for years and have given feedback multiple times about the 10 screen sequence of goals and questions that you can't skip or exit from when opening app on iOS. Infuriating when you open the app to sleep. It's otherwise amazing but this has me considering Calm. Its absolutely wild that someone there thinks this is good idea.
…. Good...

I’ve had issues with meditations stopping mid-track and jumping back to random points.  They asked me for a bunch of information then blamed my connectivity that had nothing to do with it. App is full of unnecessary and annoying additions. Not what it used to be. Don’t bother subscribing
Waste of money. Trying to get a refund for this app is impossible.  No reminder of subscriptions is sent. No emails to check in for in active accounts.  Complete waste of money, time and opportunity.

I am sorry but in what world do you think I’d want to share my progress. Why would any one do that? How often is this feature actually used? As a user it is just in my way of getting on to the next meditation. As a paid service I don’t expect to get bothered by your attempts at self promotion.
Love this. This is a great app. There are many choices available. Takes a little bit to navigate but all in all I love it.

I like the recent redesign. I particularly like the way a lotus flower opens up to communicate to you that you’ve progressed another day in meditation and kept your streak
The best Meditation app. I love it so much. It helps me to keep on track and consistent with my meditation and journaling routines.

This app is amazing!. After long days, when I go to bed this is my go-to app for rest and relaxation. The teachers are so kind and supportive! Happy & Peaceful. I have listened to a lot of other apps however Insight Timer has such a rich source of variety with something for everyday - in fact I am excited each morning to discover and do a new session

Meditation support i use daily. Such a wonderful ap with so many brilliant contributors and nifty challenges. Also the option to stay cost free which is so generous. Thank you.
Very disappointing for a wellness app. I have tried to contact insight timer help a number of times and have not received a reply
Meditation. Have been using Insight Timer for almost a decade now. I never seem to tire of the meditations/course/sleepscapes that are offered! Easy 5 starts for me

This app respects you. Thank you Insight Timer app developers and contributors. I feel your care through this work. Have been using it daily for years. Love it!. The best meditation app there is. It gives platform to so many instructors and practitioners  and gives a way to connect t with them through live events. I really love this platform and app. 🙏🏽

App has become bloated and unusable. I’ve had this app for years and enjoyed the simple meditation timer and sometimes guided meditations. This is not free. I used to have this app and use it regularly but on downloading it this time it asked for a yearly subscription.
Super. Excellent app

Why change a good app?. I use this app for the meditation timer. Haven’t used it for a while, now that I’ve returned it has some ridiculous tv static noise after the bells. Why do app creators continually ruin something that’s good?

Insight timer is a gift. I was new to meditation when I was recommended insight timer. I found a place to explore different genre’s of meditation and a variety that is fabulous.  Thank you for this gift over the past 8 years.

Love insight timer. I love this app has been a game changer in increasing healthy habits like meditation, chanting and love all the courses. Highly recommend if you want to increase healthy habits, insight timer is a great place to begin.
Brilliant. Best app for self.
Best free meditation app. Enough functionality to use without upgrading to paid.
‘Go to’ best option. I can meditate with out this app, however, if I want the option of being nurtured by many of the different choices and styles of meditation- this is my go to choice.

Best content but worst user experience. I love love love the content on this app. I am a premium subscriber for this reason. However the app is not the best user experience. If you get a phone call or text or notification or anything that would disrupt it- it doesn’t turn back on once the notification or noise has finished. You have to go back into the app and even then it often displays an error message. You cannot scroll through the content whilst you are listening to anything, once you are listening you are only able to be on that screen which is highly annoying. I wish there was an option to cut out the speech in some of the subliminal affirmations (at the start) because when you have it on repeat to listen while you sleep you’re suddenly woken by a loud voice at the start of the track. I will continue to pay for premium just because the content is so good but I really hope the user experience is updated soon
Great tool to enhance your day. I appreciate the variety of meditation styles and variations in length of time needed to practise each day.
Plenty of options to meet you where you are. Love this app. Have utilised the paid and free versions and think they both are great. Lots of variety. Good teachers.
Wow. My review was removed!. Already given feedback twice about the pop ups being the antithesis to zen and supporting neurodivergence. Seems you don’t want to know, or respond. Disappointing

Mediation and more. I’ve really enjoyed Insight Timer for my morning meditation - I use it to time my sitting. There are far more functions and previously I have found some great meditation teachers and other programs. For now, preferring free meditation, it’s perfect for me and the cats! 🐈🐈‍⬛🐈❣️
Annoying. Stop making me commit to a goal without an option to escape. It’s not how I want to practice!

In-app prompts are a put off. I contacted the app developers late last year, no reply yet, about my experience of the prompts you can’t ignore, in that instance the ‘spotification’ / end of year data about how much I’d used the app. I explained why it’s a put off for me, it’s not neurodiversity friendly (PDA), and I’d searched long and hard in the app to find where to turn these notifications off so really didn’t appreciate multiple screens you have to go through (no opt out), thinking each was the last screen and not knowing how long this was going to go for, before you can use the app. After weeks of not using the app because of this very issue, I log on to see it’s happened again! This time, ‘welcome back’ followed by another 7 screens I can’t opt out of before I can even use the app. Between this and no reply to my contact, I am inclined to delete the app and cancel my subscription. good app. Insight Timer is a versatile meditation app designed to guide users through every stage of their mindfulness journey. From the initial stages of stress and anxiety to establishing a consistent practice, this app offers a wide range of features that cater to different needs. One of the app's standout features is its progress tracking, which is crucial for maintaining consistency and seeing personal growth. Users can monitor their meditation habits through detailed statistics, which reflect how often and how long they meditate. This tracking system not only motivates users to stick with their practice but also provides a sense of achievement as they reach new milestones. The app is highly accessible, with a free download option and a variety of free trial functions, making it easy for newcomers to start without commitment. The smooth registration process and intuitive user interface ensure that even those new to meditation can begin their journey with ease. Additionally, Insight Timer offers a sense of community through theme groups and live classes, allowing users to connect with others and gain support along the way. However, there is room for improvement. Simplifying the language settings and enhancing the daily check-in feature would make the app even more user-friendly. Providing a more comprehensive preview of the app's functions could also help users better understand its offerings from the start.

There are too many checkpoints and prompts when opening the app. I don’t think there needs to be a quote and questions every time I open it. I use Insight Timer specifically for anxiety and stress, and when I need the app, I’m often looking for something that will help me right away. Having to navigate through several screens before getting to the content I want can actually add more stress and anxiety.  2)There should be a “Skip Intro” button. I appreciate that many courses and meditations include longer introductions for people who are listening for the first time. However, if I’ve already heard the introduction, I should be able to skip it and get straight to the content.  3)Challenges and courses aren’t saving my progress/location. For some reason, the challenges and courses I’m currently working through aren’t staying easily accessible. Every day, I have to navigate through the app to find the challenge or course I’m working on. It would be much better if these were saved prominently so I could quickly pick up where I left off.  Overall, the content on Insight Timer is excellent, and I really value having so much of it available. The interface is good, but with these relatively simple tweaks, I think it could be WAY better and much easier to use especially for people who are turning to the app when they’re already stressed or anxious.

There is a premium level where subscribers (at this time less than $100 USD per year) have access to pre-recorded classes as well, on a wide variety of topics, and recently teachers have been encouraged to create more tracks that are only available to the premium subscriber. I am keeping an eye on this trend. I would be very sorry if the free access degrades in any way, but I am not terribly worried at this point.  Users are free to donate directly to teachers and content creators, with the app getting 0% of the donation. One thing to keep an eye on: recently Apple has decided to take 30% of all donations to teachers of live classes, a huge bite out of what is a very small amount of money that they are getting. You can get around this by not donating while the class is going on, if you use an Apple device. Instead you can go straight to the teacher’s page and donate there. They will then get 100% instead of 70%.  There is an awful lot of material on this app and it might take you awhile to find the teachers or classes that you resonate best with. Now, if the screen dims, or if I try to go dark to try and fall asleep, it illuminates after each track and stops so I have to hit play after every single track…what’s the point of wasting hours of time building playlists that don’t work and function like playlists???  The preview option is redundant and irritating and I see no way to turn it off. If I tapped a track before, it played 20-30 seconds of the track. That way I could tell if I liked the subject, voice, music, background, recording quality, etc. Now it goes to a different screen with a bunch of other tracks that have nothing in common with the one I want to just hear for a few seconds, and if I’m building a playlist it takes twice as long if I’m focusing on one teacher because I have to exit out of 2screens not just one and now it’s been over an hour of me trying to just meditate when I would’ve completed my nightly routine and been at calm, but it’s essentially useless. I’m about to cancel my subscription, or..it could just be that instead of this being an easy lovely peaceful app like it has been the last few years for me, it’s turned into a nightmare. LOVE it - Only One Issue. I’ve recommended this app to hundreds of patients over the years and use it all the time myself. The ONLY reason I consider trying/recommending an alternative is that I don’t see a way to change the “streaks“ display from consecutive days, to # of days of meditation that week..  regardless of the goal it made you set. So they finish a meditation, feel great & proud of themself.. and instead of celebrating 5 days of meditation that wk, it’s like “ope sorry, you missed yesterday so we’re gonna show you a 1 instead of a 5.”   Seems small but it takes away from that feeling and for a lot of folks... it’s enough to break their habit and confidence or shift the mindset. I preach to patients that perfection isn’t the goal so this is counterintuitive, but I value the tracking, goal setting, and accountability to goals set for themselves.   Maybe it’s not technically a streak if it’s not consecutive days but maybe, given the purpose of meditation and this app, there’s another name for it or strategy or ability to set it for days in a given week.. so people feel good and maintain momentum 🤷🏻‍♀️ Just a thought. It’s where I go to unplug, ground myself and literally *close my eyes.* What’s kept me loyal to IT is how calming and low-stimulation the user experience is — it used to be so simple and practical, like the Reddit of meditation apps. I loved that it never really changed. So waking up one morning to find a carousel of *meditation videos* (who is asking for these, seriously?) suddenly featured at the top of the home screen, with no way to turn the feature off, feels manipulative and totally inconsistent with the app’s original purpose. Seeing so many faces staring back at me (with sleek, professional lighting and backgrounds) when I’ve opened the app specifically to get away from that vibe grosses me out, like self-improvement is being TikTokified.  Miss me with this redesign. If there truly is a demand for video content in this space (which I find hard to fathom), there are ways to meet it without forcing the rest of us to go down the scroll hole with you. I’m taking my meditation practice elsewhere, and I hope everyone serious about their practice does too.

Best meditation app, but…. This is absolutely my favorite meditation app, but I cancelled my subscription today.  While I love the vast number of guided meditations this app offers, I primarily just use its ‘timer’ feature. This is a part of the app that is already full enough in the free version that I didn’t NEED my subscription.  So, why did I cancel? Because I like to gamify my life. I had a streak of over 300 days of meditation achieved in the app’s “Milestones”. You can miss up to three days of using the app per month and still tell the app that you did meditate, thus keeping your milestones.   I meditate every day. My meditations don’t need an app, nor do most of them do I do with the app open. But the app assumes that if I tell it I meditated more than 3 times in the month without the app being open that I’m lying. I lost my milestone streak. This kinda deflated my motivation of keeping this app as a subscription, as this gamification was the main reason I justified opening it before many of my meditations.
Lie Changing. The end.  Thank you,  thank you,  thank you.

6.5 years. I have been using this app since I started meditating, about six and a half years ago. For me, meditation is about building that place within, outside the activity of the mind, and really expanding my awareness.  I am very grateful to Insight Timer for having the familiarity of a little pebble stone train to return back there each time.

Pretty good but with design flaws. I’ve used Insight Timer maybe 700 times so I’m definitely a “user.” It works fine but there is one big design flaw that is truly irritating. When you finish meditating, the “continue” (“finished” that is) button is right on top of a discard session button. Probably at least twice I week I finish meditating but discard the session if I’m not super careful to not brush the discard option. Why, oh why, are these two completely opposite and not recallable options stacked on top of one another! Plus, over the years, it seems like the app has become bloated with features. Some of us just want a meditation timer. The other features are great — but I wish there were just a minimalist timer setting so I don’t have to always skip past multiple things I’m not interested in. Just saying.
